text:
sam: Noticed a recurring p99 uplift on the continuous-batcher after the prefetch-window change. Small/short routes seem affected. Anyone digging in?

nora: Yep; p99 up ~25ms for <=12-token requests on batcher-shard-3. p95 unchanged.

diego: Trace shows tiny reqs queued behind a prefetched large request that extended the coalesce window. Example: 
```
enqueue id=xyz size=9 prefetch=5 wait=21ms held_by=req_large_42
```

fiona: That matches the hypothesis: raising prefetch helps medium throughput but increases chance of a large request entering the window and delaying tiny joins. 

sam: Ideas on mitigation?

nora: Short term: rollback prefetch on the tiny-shard. Midterm: two options we've discussed before: 1) soft_reserve per-route so tiny routes bypass deep prefetch, 2) microfast lane (dedicated tiny queue).

diego: Also consider deadline_hint propagation: admission could prefer low-latency requests when route.deadline_hint < threshold. Cheap to wire and low-risk.

fiona: One more: adaptive prefetch controller that reduces window when p99 breaches SLO and increases when stable. Simple feedback loop.

sam: Ops: If we rollback, add metrics first so we can prove cause: join_wait_by_size, hold_reason, prefetched_join_rate, eviction_rate.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: change(prefetch=5) applied to cluster/batchers-main at 01:12 UTC.

sam: Ok rollback vote: roll back to prefetch=3 on shard-3 now, add telemetry, then canary adaptive prefetch on shard-canary.

nora: I'll open the metrics PR (histograms + tenant/size_bucket/hold_reason labels).

diego: I'll prototype deadline-aware admission and a small adaptive controller in a branch. We can canary it next week.

fiona: For documentation / RFC follow-up: need a clear decision matrix: when to prefer soft_reserve vs microfast lane vs adaptive prefetch. Each has complexity & fairness tradeoffs.

sam: Agreed. Action items: 1) rollback shard-3 (sam) 2) metrics PR (nora) 3) prototype controller (diego) 4) on-call monitor p50/p95/p99 and eviction deltas (fiona). Timeline: rollback now, metrics within 48h, prototype in 7 days.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback(prefetch=3) applied to cluster/batchers-shard-3 at 01:35 UTC. Monitoring enabled.

infra-bot: alert-bot: p99 returned to baseline within 9 minutes of rollback (automated check).

sam: Thanks. Please drop sim runs and dashboards here once available so RFC can pick long-term path. :thumbsup:
